name: craftflow
description: Judgment-driven engineering for Codex: understand the problem, choose a proportionate change, and verify the result.

interface.shortDescription: Find the cause, scope the change, and verify the result.
interface.longDescription: Use CraftFlow when a diagnosis needs checking, a repair could become a rewrite, or completion needs evidence. Set investigates, plans, and reviews without edits. Go implements and verifies changes. Choose either directly; Set is not a prerequisite for Go. Technical references load only when needed.
defaultPrompt: Use $craftflow-set to investigate this problem or review this change without editing code.
Use $craftflow-go to implement this change and verify the result.
